name: Kawareru Shimai
source:
One year after the death of their mother.
2 sisters go to university with the money from their father who rarely visits them recently.
But their peaceful life is suddenly broken when they are kidnapped and forced to sell their body...

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE056412.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
母亲去世一年后，
两姐妹依靠最近很少回家的父亲提供的钱，就读于大学。
然而，她们突然遭到绑架，被迫出卖身体，平静生活就此破碎…
